gml:Dictionary.gml:description: This dictionary contains named correlation methods used to derive interpreted CPT parameters (soil behavior type, Ic, relative density, undrained shear strength, soil unit weight, peak friction angle). A calculated CPT parameter should reference the method used so that consumers can reproduce and qualify the result, per the interpretation reporting practice recommended by CPT vendors.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS CPT Interpretation Methods

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Non-normalized soil behavior type chart (qt vs friction ratio, 12 zones).
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Robertson et al. 1986

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Normalized soil behavior type index (Ic) framework for CPT-based soil classification.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Robertson & Wride 1998

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Normalized soil behavior type (SBTn) chart, Qt vs Fr.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Robertson 1990

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Normalized soil behavior type using Qtn vs Fr (CPT 2009 update); default SBT method when unit weights and stresses are reported.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Robertson 2009

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Revised simplified soil behavior type chart, qt/pa vs Rf.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Robertson 2010 (CPT10)

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Relative density (Dr) correlation for sands from normalized cone resistance.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Jamiolkowski et al. 2003

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Peak effective friction angle for sands from normalized cone tip resistance qc1.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Kulhawy & Mayne 1990

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Undrained shear strength from Su = (qt - sigma_v)/Nkt, where Nkt is selected or derived from Bq or Fr.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Undrained Shear Strength via Nkt

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Soil unit weight assigned per Robertson SBT zone. Note: CPT vendors apply multiple unit-weight methods; the full set should be enumerated with vendor input.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Unit Weight by SBT Zone
